items.name: webcodex
items.description: Give cloud AI agents a real development environment on your own machines.

items.name: watch-skill
items.description: Video understanding and self-verification for AI agents. Turn videos, streams, and agent screen recordings into searchable, timestamped evidence—then use THE LOOP to inspect, fix, and verify the work. MCP, CLI, REST, local-first.

items.name: agent-orchestrator
items.description: Agent IDE that enables you to manage fleets of coding agents. It comes with an agentic orchestrator that plans tasks, spawns agents, and autonomously handles CI fixes, merge conflicts, and code reviews.

items.name: Claude-of-Tanks
items.description: A World of Tanks-style, Vite-powered, engine-free pure Three.js armored combat simulator resolving plate-level armor, ballistics, modules, spotting, and physics, with 110+ vehicles and 16 destructible battlefields. Playable entirely in the browser on desktop and mobile devices. Built end-to-end by a multi-agent Claude/Codex pipeline.

items.name: local-operator
items.description: AI agents platform that gives you a workspace with an integrated team of personal assistants that can work behind the scenes to handle daily monotonous tasks.

items.name: maka
items.description: Apache Maka (Incubating) is a local-first AI agent workspace. Model messages, tool calls, tool results, permission decisions, and termination events are recorded as an append-only log.

items.name: langwatch
items.description: The platform for LLM evaluations and AI agent testing

items.name: wind-comic
items.description: Multi-agent AI pipeline that turns one line of text into a finished short-form drama: script, cinematic storyboards, character-consistent video. Provider-agnostic (OpenAI/Claude, MJ, Minimax, Veo/Sora, fal, ComfyUI). MIT.

items.name: Browser4
items.description: Browser4 — an AI-native browser engine for autonomous agents, intelligent extraction, and large-scale web automation.

items.name: wmux
items.description: Run Claude Code, Codex & Gemini in parallel on Windows & macOS — git worktree fan-out with atomic hunk adoption, approval gates, reboot-surviving sessions
